title: Awakened Plugin Manifest
description: Validates plugins/<plugin-name>/.claude-plugin/plugin.json for every Awakened plugin. Enforces N-3 kebab-case naming with the marketplace name prohibited as a plugin name (N-4), MIT-only licensing (D-08), the D-15 hook budget, and the HR-2 MCP allowlist. The $id is an identifier only and is never fetched at runtime (HR-6).
$comment: R-4: the official Claude Code plugin manifest field set is open-ended and is re-verified at Phase 2 (SPEC section 0), so additionalProperties stays true and only policy-constrained fields are declared. Prohibitions are grounded, not invented: lspServers (HR-3), dependencies (P-1 independent installability and B-8 satellites never becoming core dependencies), experimental (nothing ships behind an unaudited flag under E-1/E-2), and the custom component-path fields skills/commands/agents/workflows (SPEC section 3 fixes the per-plugin layout, so redirecting component discovery elsewhere would put components outside the tree the validator walks). mcpServers accepts only the inline object restricted to the two sanctioned servers - the path-string form is rejected because a referenced file is outside this schema's reach and would let arbitrary servers in behind an HR-2 gate that never opens.

name.description: Lowercase kebab-case plugin name (N-3). Must equal the plugin directory name; that cross-check is enforced by scripts/validate. The marketplace name is prohibited as a plugin name because it would be the catch-all N-4 forbids. The nine-name Tier-1 set is enforced by the validator rather than pinned here, so the schema does not drift from ADR-014 and template slots stay validatable.

version.description: Semantic version, declared explicitly so a release is never identified by a bare commit SHA.

description.description: One-paragraph statement of the plugin's responsibility and its boundary (B-1…B-8).

repository.description: Canonical home (D-03). Distribution is this repository only (D-02).

license.description: Awakened is MIT end to end (D-08).

hooks.description: Path to the plugin's single hook configuration file, kebab-case per N-3. D-15 caps the budget at one hook per plugin, load-bearing only; the per-plugin count and the owning-plugin restriction are enforced by scripts/validate and by the allOf rule below.

outputStyles.description: Output-style directory. SPEC section 4 assigns output styles to aura alone; the allOf rule below enforces that.

mcpServers.description: Inline MCP server map, restricted to the two servers P-5 and HR-2 permit. The path-string form is deliberately not accepted: a referenced file cannot be constrained here, so it would bypass the allowlist entirely.

allOf.$comment: D-15 hook budget: only super-saiyan and rinnegan are pre-authorized to declare a hook.
SPEC section 4: aura owns output styles.
